data.body: 2026-10-15 follow-up to the MCP reachability change: chat start had become slow because freeze/pass assembly opened MCP sessions (initialize, 30s timeout; and my first change let a failed freeze be retried by restore_frozen_mcp in the same command). Now the message path never contacts a server: WorkflowExecutionPipeline::prepare_mcp_sessions only installs the Run peer/secrets and returns McpToolRuntimeV1::cached_snapshots (sessions an earlier call opened); discover_workflow_mcp and restore_frozen_mcp describe tools from the catalog saved in Settings until a live session exists; only tool_loop::run_mcp_tool calls open_frozen. A call is dispatched with the hash the answering session advertises now (advertised_schema_hash), so a Chat that never reached the server, or one whose tool changed, is called instead of failing SchemaDrift. Tests prove zero initialize calls at start; desktop cargo test --lib 635 passed. Design clarification updated.
